description: Godot node: add a node of a built-in type (e.g. Sprite2D, CollisionShape2D, Label) or an instance of a .tscn scene, with optional initial properties. Undoable in the editor.

parent.description: Parent node path; "." for the scene root.

properties.description: Property values. Godot types accept literals ("Vector2(10, 20)"), arrays ([10, 20]), "#ff0000" colors, "res://" paths to load resources, or {"new": "CircleShape2D", "properties": {...}}.

scene.description: Scene file, e.g. "res://main.tscn". Defaults to the scene open in the editor; required when the editor is closed.

type.description: Node class, e.g. "Sprite2D". Give type or instance.

name: godot_node_add
title: Add node
